name: Bake Sausage Southwest
description: A layered casserole featuring sausage, tortillas, cheese, and salsa, perfect for a hearty breakfast or brunch.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb bulk pork sausage, cooked and drained
4 cans (4 oz each) green chilies, drained and chopped
2 cups (8 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2 cup sour cream and salsa for serving

recipeInstructions.text: In a greased 13x9x2 inch baking pan, create a layer of tortillas.
In a bowl, beat eggs and milk together, then pour over tortillas.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Layer with cooked sausage, chopped green chilies, and shredded cheese.
Repeat layers as needed, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Refrigerate overnight, covered.
Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.
Arrange tomato slices on top and bake uncovered at 350°F for 50 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting and serve with sour cream and salsa.

keywords: Southwestern casserole, sausage bake, breakfast strata

_similar.name: Saucy Sausages
_similar.description: A flavorful Oktoberfest sausage dish baked in a rich sauce made with chili sauce, salsa, and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: First, boil sausages until almost done or brown them in a frying pan.
In a separate bowl, combine the barbecue sauce, HP sauce, chili sauce, garlic salt, salsa sauce, seasoning salt, ketchup, and onion powder.
Place the sausages in the bottom of a roasting pan or baking dish. Sprinkle with the three spices (garlic salt, seasoning salt, onion powder). Cover with the sauce mixture.
Cover and bake in a 350 °F oven for approximately ½ hour.
Can be served with rice.

_similar.keywords: Oktoberfest sausages, saucy sausages, baked sausages

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Sausage Balls
_similar.description: Crispy sausage and cheddar balls perfect for snacking or parties, made with biscuit mix and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the sausage in a frying pan until fully cooked.
Add the cheddar soup to the browned sausage and stir until well mixed.
Combine the sausage mixture with the biscuit mix and blend until a dough forms.
Form the dough into small balls (about 50 total).
Place the sausage balls on a cookie sheet and bake in a preheated 450°F oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

_similar.keywords: sausage balls, cheddar soup, biscuit mix, party snack

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling
